note: The D435 depth module (D430) with a global-shutter OV9782 RGB camera synchronised with the depth sensors and a 6-DoF IMU (BMI085, not modelled); added in datasheet revision 023 (March 2026). Poses: the body origin is the left imager's optical centre, the datasheet's depth origin (section 4.8.1); the right imager one baseline along -y, optical axes parallel to body x (the rectified geometry). The projector is placed at the baseline midpoint as an ASSUMPTION (pose_stated false; drawn but not dimensioned). Not stated: pixel size, distortion coefficients ("Distortion <= 1.5%"), subpixel accuracy: the lens model is pinhole, a labelled assumption. FOVs vary by about +/-3 degrees unit to unit (Table 3-49 note 3). max_range_m is the upper figure of the "Range" feature line ("over", "varies with lighting conditions"). Streams are the USB 3.1 Gen 1 tables; power_w is the "All Components" power at the Max Operating Mode (section 7.4). RGB: OV9782, global shutter, 90 (H) / 65 (V) / 98 (D) degrees (Table 3-49), offset not stated: placed at the depth origin as an ASSUMPTION (pose_stated false). The sources disagree on the RGB resolution: the feature list and Table 4-5 go up to 1280 x 720, the store page says "Up to 1280 x 800" (the OV9782's full array, as on the D455): the FOV is taken to refer to 1280 x 800 (an ASSUMPTION) and the 16:9 streams are then a centred crop (labelled). RGB streams are Table 4-5 (YUY2); the D436 "doesn't support USB2". power_w is Table 7-8's D436 figure, 3461.47 mW (the RGB imager row reads "118.5 / 177" mW for D435x / D436). Depth start point 4.2 mm (Table 4-17). Size 90 x 25 x 25 mm and 75 g (Table 3-52, D43x; store page 90 x 25 x 25 mm). Both the depth and the RGB sensors can be synced by an external trigger (section 3.7.4). Store page: ideal range 0.3-3 m, min-Z ~28 cm, accuracy <2% at 2 m, RGB "Up to 60 fps", RGB FOV "90 x 65 +/-3".

holes.what: Figure 10-9 (D435/D435i drawing): "2X M3 MOUNTING POINTS, MAX INSERTION DEPTH 3MM" on the back face, 45 apart; the pair's centre is not dimensioned (null). Note under the figure: "Recommended torque for both M3 mounting points is 0.4 Nm".

Table 4-20: "From Centerline of 1/4-20 To Left Imager" 17.5 mm for the D43x (the body origin is the left imager, so y = -17.5 mm, towards the right imager); its position front to back and its depth are not stated (null).

projector.optical_power_what: D400 Series Datasheet (the first source), Table 3-17, Wide (D43x, D45x) Infrared Projector Parameters: "Optical Power 360 mW average", "Laser Wavelength 850 nm ± 10 nm nominal @ 20°C"; read 2026-11-07. An average over the PWM drive; the datasheet says laser power is halved when the depth module is above 60 °C (Laser Thermal Control). The laser power is also a control, Table 4-23 "Manual Laser Power (mW) Laser Power setting (30 mW steps)" from 0 to 360: the 360 mW used here is its maximum, so the wash-out is predicted at full laser power; a lower setting gives a weaker pattern (not modelled).

depth.range_text: Range 0.2 m to over 3 m (varies with lighting conditions)

rms_error.text: RMS error (or spatial noise) <= 2%, at <= 2 m, 80% ROI, HD resolution (Table 4-15); measured on a texture-less white target, laser 150 mW, auto exposure

sync.what: Datasheet section 3.7.4: "For D415, D455, D455f D456 and D436 both the depth and RGB sensors can be synced by an external trigger."
